question: If the difference of the mode and median of a data is 38, then the difference of the median and mean is:
solution:
Given:

The difference between the mode and median of a data is 38

Concept used:

Mode = 3 Median – 2 Mean

Calculation:

According to the question,

Mode - Median = 38

We know,

Mode = 3 Median – 2 Mean

⇒ 3 Median - Mode = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 Median + (Median - Mode) = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 Median - 38 = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 (Median - Mean) = 38

⇒ Median - Mean = 19

**∴ The difference between the median and mean is 19.**
